MSFT.title: Cloud AI capex cycle widens across hyperscalers and infrastructure suppliers
MSFT.summary: Enterprise AI spending remains concentrated in cloud and infrastructure, with Microsoft positioned as both a platform owner and a capex beneficiary through Azure demand.

AVGO.title: Cloud AI capex cycle widens across hyperscalers and infrastructure suppliers
AVGO.summary: Broadcom stays tied to the same cloud build-out cycle, with switching and custom silicon demand reinforcing a favorable infrastructure spending backdrop.

TSM.title: Advanced-node foundry utilization tightens as accelerator demand stays elevated
TSM.summary: Leading-edge capacity remains a strategic bottleneck, reinforcing TSMC's pricing power and its leverage to persistent accelerator and high-performance compute demand.

ORCL.title: Cloud AI capex cycle widens across hyperscalers and infrastructure suppliers
ORCL.summary: Oracle remains in the conversation as enterprise buyers look for additional cloud capacity, though the article is more ecosystem-oriented than Oracle-specific.

SPOT.title: Spotify ad mix and premium retention support a steadier margin narrative
SPOT.summary: The latest channel checks point to resilient premium churn and better monetization of the ad-supported tier, supporting a more constructive operating margin outlook.

CRM.title: Enterprise software pricing discipline offsets slower seat expansion
CRM.summary: Salesforce is benefiting from disciplined pricing and tighter cost control even as seat growth normalizes, leaving sentiment balanced but still constructive.

INTU.title: Tax software demand holds firm as automation features deepen customer lock-in
INTU.summary: The article frames Intuit as a quality compounder, with workflow automation helping defend pricing and embed the platform more deeply into small-business finance operations.

V.title: Cross-border card spend stays firm despite softer domestic discretionary trends
V.summary: Visa's cross-border and travel-linked volumes remain supportive, offsetting mixed signals in domestic discretionary categories and preserving a healthy payments backdrop.

MU.title: Memory pricing stabilizes as AI server demand absorbs premium supply
MU.summary: Micron stands to benefit from tighter high-bandwidth memory supply and improving pricing discipline, though the tone remains tied to cyclical execution.

XOM.title: Integrated energy cash returns stay central as crude range remains contained
XOM.summary: Exxon remains supported by capital-return durability and downstream stability, even with crude prices moving sideways rather than breaking out.

VOO.title: Mega-cap concentration keeps index performance tied to a narrow leadership cohort
VOO.summary: Broad-market ETF performance still hinges on a concentrated set of large-cap winners, making VOO more sensitive to leadership breadth than headline index stability suggests.

RIOT.title: Bitcoin miners lean harder on fleet efficiency as hash-rate competition rises
RIOT.summary: Riot's positioning depends less on headline crypto beta and more on execution around power costs, uptime, and fleet efficiency as mining competition intensifies.

MAGS.title: Mega-cap concentration keeps index performance tied to a narrow leadership cohort
MAGS.summary: The same mega-cap leadership theme shows up even more directly in concentrated thematic funds, where a small set of technology names dominate overall exposure.

DASH.title: Local commerce platforms push higher-value ad units to expand take rates
DASH.summary: DoorDash is seeing incremental monetization opportunities from sponsored placements and merchant tools, supporting a healthier unit-economics conversation.

CLSK.title: Bitcoin miners lean harder on fleet efficiency as hash-rate competition rises
CLSK.summary: CleanSpark shares the same operating theme as peers: power sourcing and fleet performance matter more than simple crypto price moves at the margin.

IBM.title: Enterprise software pricing discipline offsets slower seat expansion
IBM.summary: IBM appears in the broader enterprise software discussion as buyers stay selective, with demand skewing toward automation and infrastructure modernization rather than broad expansion.

SNAP.title: Digital ad auction clearing improves for scaled consumer apps
SNAP.summary: Snap's ad environment looks steadier as campaign demand broadens, though execution still matters more than pure macro relief for the stock narrative.
